objective.text: Apply a field comparison rule to a date interval and test the equality boundary.

difficulty.rationale: Test the equality boundary that distinguishes inclusive from strict ordering.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A date range may start and end on the same day, but may not end earlier. A developer changes end from after_or_equal:start to after:start. Which previously valid case detects that regression?

options.rationale: Equality passes the inclusive rule but fails the strictly-after rule.
An earlier date fails both rules and therefore does not distinguish the regression.
options.misconception: An earlier date fails both rules and therefore does not distinguish the regression.

options.rationale: Invalid date text is rejected regardless of the equality policy.
options.misconception: Invalid date text is rejected regardless of the equality policy.

options.rationale: A later date passes both rules, so it does not reveal the change.
options.misconception: A later date passes both rules, so it does not reveal the change.
